notes.title: Showcasing at BitSummit 2024
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Last month I showcased Rhythm Rabbit at BitSummit 2024 in Kyoto Japan. This was the second and biggest indie game event I ever took part in. The event lasted 3 days and had approximately 40K visitors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956892/e9b2afa2028a66a3a5f2795c5453cfd1822ef8a6.jpg[/img]
Business day was rather quiet compared to the two public days at which both my computers were mostly occupied. People lined up and even came back with friends to have them play the demo as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956892/dde77cf8afdc4bd465b5749875a5d52ec3e11192.jpg[/img]
I was absolutely exhausted at the end, but so glad I was able to participate. I had nothing but great reactions and fun interactions. I think it was a great success!

Thank you for reading ^^

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
I launched the demo! It contains the complete first biome of the game. Don't let the cutesy art style fool you though, as it's quite the challenge! See if you can make it all the way to the boss stage.

I would very much appreciate your feedback on this demo. You can either drop a comment here or use the in-game feedback button, that will direct you to a Google form.

Keep in mind that the game is still under development. Aside from some UI, art and music being temporarily placeholders, some aspects of the game, including difficulty, might differ from the final product. I will keep balancing and updating this demo based on your feedback.

notes.title: Join The Pre-Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
In order to get some feedback, I decided to do an early playtest. I'm really testing out the waters with this one, so I decided to keep it rather limited and exclusive to my newsletter subscribers.

So if you'd like to test out the game early, receive updates and be involved in its development, you can subscribe to my newsletter using the link below.

It can take anywhere between a few hours and a day or two for you to receive a key, since I have to send them out manually.

I'm planning on releasing an early public demo as well, so your feedback would be really appreciated.
